business_summary: WG TECH (Jiang Xi) Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of glass-based circuit boards and related electronic devices in China. The company's products include mini and micro-LED glass substrates, semiconductor advanced packaging substrates, CPO applications and RF devices, MIP carrier and direct display substrates, UTG ultra-thin flexible glasses, CPI transparent polyimides, and touch products. It is involved in the FPD optoelectronic glass finishing business, such as glass thinning, coating, cutting, and photolithography. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Xinyu, China.
